text: Testing plays a key role in modern software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, such as a single function, while integration tests make sure different parts of a system work together correctly. Many teams also use test-driven development, where tests are written before the code itself. This approach helps developers think carefully about what the code should do. Tests also give programmers confidence. When they change or improve existing code, they can run the tests again and quickly see if something breaks. As a result, testing saves time, reduces stress, and helps teams deliver more reliable software to their users.
